title: Come to Our Help

questions.question: O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have told us, what deeds you performed in their days, in the days of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:1 (ESV): "...what deeds you performed in their days, in the days of old:"

questions.question: You with your own hand drove out the nations, but them you did what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:2 (ESV): "you with your own hand drove out the nations, but them you planted;"

questions.question: For not by their own sword did they win the land, nor did their own arm save whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:3 (ESV): "For not by their own sword did they win the land, nor did their own arm save them,"

questions.question: But your right hand and your arm, and the light of your face, for you delighted in whom?
You are my King, O God; ordain salvation for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:4 (ESV): "You are my King, O God; ordain salvation for Jacob!"

questions.question: Through you we push down our foes; through your name we tread down those who rise up against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:5 (ESV): "Through you we push down our foes; through your name we tread down those who rise up against us."

questions.question: For not in my bow do I trust, nor can my sword save whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:6 (ESV): "For not in my bow do I trust, nor can my sword save me."

questions.question: In God we have boasted continually, and we will give thanks to your name when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:8 (ESV): "In God we have boasted continually, and we will give thanks to your name forever."

questions.question: But you have rejected us and disgraced us and have not gone out with our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:9 (ESV): "But you have rejected us and disgraced us and have not gone out with our armies."

questions.question: You have made us like sheep for slaughter and have scattered us among the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:11 (ESV): "You have made us like sheep for slaughter and have scattered us among the nations."

questions.question: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten you, and we have not been false to your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:17 (ESV): "...and we have not been false to your covenant."

questions.question: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god, would not God discover what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:20-21 (ESV): "...would not God discover this? For he knows the secrets of the heart."

questions.question: Yet for your sake we are killed all the day long; we are regarded as sheep to be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:22 (ESV): "...we are regarded as sheep to be slaughtered."

questions.question: Awake! Why are you sleeping, O Lord? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:23 (ESV): "Awake! Why are you sleeping, O Lord? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever!"

questions.question: Rise up; come to our help! Redeem us for the sake of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 44:26 (ESV): "Rise up; come to our help! Redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love!"

key_verse_text: Rise up; come to our help! Redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love!
